firstPlayerRule: Shuffle the initiative cards for the mice and the minion types that will be on the board at the start of the encounter. Deal them onto the initiative track in order; the card in the highest position takes the first turn.
clarifications: A minion card can take the first turn. Initiative follows the cards, rather than a fixed player seated at the table.
Follow any chapter-specific setup instructions before determining the opening initiative order.
